Conversion Prompt for vendor subfolder.

version 0.01 created on 18 december 2025 by Skybuck Flying.

Step 1. Read textfile: "AI System Prompts\JulesConversionPrompt.md"

Step 2. Read textfile: "vendor\VendorMappingV3.txt"

Step 3. Convert all *.go files to *.pas or *.dpr from the VendorMappingV3.txt
        The converted *.pas or *.dpr files should stay next to the *.go files. So keep then in the same folders/subfolders.
        Some *.pas files already exist. Figure out which already exist, which ones are missing and which ones are incomplete
        and need further work/conversion.
